targets.target: Turgame (turgame.com, Turkish digital games/gift cards platform)
targets.access_requirements: Confirmed B2B/dealer program on TWO surfaces. (1) wholesale.turgame.com — 'Turgame B2B - Digital Gift Card Wholesale Solutions': apply via /apply-now/ form (Customer Type Individual|Corporate, Country, National ID/Tax ID, Company name*, Tax Number*, Tax Office optional); team reviews application; after approval account gets wholesale pricing and bulk orders. Landing page: 'Connect via API or order in bulk with wholesale pricing'; 'Automate your business with our robust JSON API. Real-time stock checking, instant order processing, and automatic code delivery'; 'tiered pricing' for CSV bulk orders. /products page How-It-Works: 1) apply online -> credentials, 2) integrate with API (technical team helps), 3) buy at competitive wholesale prices. (2) Turgame Dealer Programme (Dealer Agreement v1.0.0, last updated 2026-05-23, public copy mirrored at fodga.com/bayi-sozlesmesi): tiers Bronze (₺0+ trailing 12-month revenue) / Silver (₺5,000+) / Gold (₺20,000+) / Platinum (₺50,000+), re-calculated monthly; exact discount percentages confidential inside Dealer Portal ('Exact percentages and the strategic-partner override are documented inside the Dealer Portal'); KYC = tax ID/VKN + bank account for payouts + signed agreement; settlement via Turgame Wallet with dealer discount applied at order time; sub-dealers allowed with responsibility. No deposit minimum published.

targets.raw_notes: Discovery path: turgame.com 404-page footer contained links to wholesale.turgame.com and /tapi/. wholesale.turgame.com is a WooCommerce store whose PUBLIC Store API exposes the whole B2B catalog (4,739 SKUs, TRY). Retail turgame.com is also WooCommerce; its Store API respects the WOOCS currency cookie (set via https://www.turgame.com/?currency=TRY), giving same-currency retail prices. 225 exact-name matches => public B2B catalog is priced ~0.7-1.3% below retail (avg 0.91%). IMPORTANT NUANCE: this ~1% is the pre-login LIST price of the wholesale catalog; the real dealer economics = Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum tier discounts (percentages confidential in Dealer Portal) applied at order time via Turgame Wallet. So the observable public gap is small but the program is real; deeper discounts exist behind approval (per agreement wording 'high profit margins', 'special promotions'). Dealer agreement is published on fodga.com (a Turgame-powered Next.js storefront) — exact page 'Dealer Agreement — Turgame, Last updated: May 23, 2026, Version 1.0.0'. No deposit minimum found. Wholesale application has no stated volume minimum (form asks 'estimated monthly purchase volume'). Searches used: 'turgame bayi', 'turgame.com bayi fiyatları dealer wholesale', 'turgame API entegrasyonu', 'turgame bayi indirimi dealer discount percent', '"wholesale.turgame.com" OR "turgame wholesale" price list'.

targets.access_requirements: NO public API or wholesale/reseller purchase program for buyers found. api.gamsgo.com is a live PRIVATE JSON gateway (root returns {"code":404,"message":"Page not found"}); /api-docs redirects to homepage; help.gamsgo.com has no API category. What exists instead: (1) SELLER program (Merchant Center at gamsgo.com/sell) — anyone can apply as Individual or Enterprise seller; KYC required: photo of government ID (ID card/passport/driver's license/student ID) with 'gamsgo.com' visible in background + selfie holding the same ID; legal age required; review by team. Seller onboarding contacts: Telegram @GamsGoSellerJoin3, WhatsApp +44 7842 296351, SellerJoin@gamsgo.com. (2) Affiliate program — open signup (1 minute per their page), unique link/promo code; higher rates negotiable for large followings.

targets.raw_notes: GamsGo verdict for MEC-5: NOT an API/wholesale supplier in the ProdSeller/StackVault sense. It is a subscription-sharing marketplace with (a) first-party retail (Direct GamsGo), (b) C2C marketplace where sellers set prices (the closest thing to 'wholesale' — becoming a seller with KYC), (c) seller commissions 4.90-9.90% by category with Lv.1-5 tier commission discounts, (d) affiliate commissions 10%/5% standard, up to 18% recurring. api.gamsgo.com exists but is private (their own SPA backend). No published bulk/reseller purchase pricing found anywhere. Cross-supplier context: GamsGo CapCut Pro $7.49/mo vs ProdSeller CapCut Pro 30d public $1.70 / API $1.29 (from MEC-5 master file) — different product forms (shared-slot 30d upgrade vs full sub) but shows GamsGo sits at the expensive retail end for this SKU family. Searches used: 'gamsgo API', 'gamsgo wholesale reseller bulk discount partner', 'gamsgo B2B bulk purchase reseller program buy subscriptions wholesale'.
